mostWorthwhile.text: Building the two kinds of proteins was worthwhile because their different locations helped explain how cells with the same DNA can do different jobs.

leastWorthwhile.text: The second RNA-and-protein sequence felt somewhat repetitive after the muscle sequence, though the comparison had a purpose.

surprise.text: I was interested that the supporting cells released protein into the surrounding material, while the muscle cells kept pulling proteins inside.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary: the messenger pictures and the earlier protein-building example suggested the pairings. The details of how messengers activate genes were not explained.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because seeing how these different cells become larger tissues sounds interesting, especially after the muscle-cell result pointed toward a later chapter.
